```{r}
ds_individuals = import.protist.morph.data()
```

```{r}
#Rename columns
ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>% 
  rename(patch_type = eco_metaeco_type,
         body_area_µm2 = mean_area)
```

```{r}
#Reorder patches
ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>%
  mutate(patch_type = factor(patch_type,
                             levels = patch_types_ordered))
```

```{r}
#Select columns we want. 
ds_individuals = ds_individuals %>%
    select(time_point,
           day, 
           file, 
           culture_ID, 
           system_nr, 
           patch_type,
           trophic_type,
           patch_size, 
           patch_size_ml,
           flow,
           flow_ml,
           metaecosystem, 
           metaecosystem_type, 
           body_area_µm2,
           N_frames)
```
